mapper.select: SELECT r.*, a.title AS activity_title, u.real_name AS customer_name, u.phone AS customer_phone FROM activity_registration r LEFT JOIN activity a ON r.activity_id = a.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_registration (registration_no, activity_id, user_id, activity_type, remark, audit_status) VALUES (#{registrationNo}, #{activityId}, #{userId}, #{activityType}, #{remark}, #{auditStatus})
